hotbar_numbers.setting.shown.tooltip: Whether each hotbar slot shows the key that selects it. Nothing shows in spectator mode or while the HUD is hidden (F1).
hotbar_numbers.setting.only_rebound.tool: Off: every slot shows its key. On: a slot shows its key only when it is not the usual 1 to 9.
hotbar_numbers.setting.corner.tooltip: Where in the slot the key shows. Bottom right is where a stack's count is drawn, so it covers the count.
hotbar_numbers.setting.color.tooltip: The colour of the key names. They always have a shadow.
